method: Existing-file SQLite URI mode=ro&immutable=1; PRAGMA query_only=ON; aggregate SELECT only; no application imports or route calls
interpretation: COUNT(*) includes every event type, not only pageviews; distinct sessions are not distinct people. With analytics scripts excluded and raw HTTP probes that do not execute JavaScript, no new analytics rows are expected. A lack of new rows does not prove static website failure. Immutable mode ignores WAL, so admission requires no WAL and unchanged size/mtime before and after.
